papers.title: A Machine Learning Implementation to Predictive Maintenance and Monitoring of Industrial Compressors
papers.summary: This paper details the integration of machine learning and IoT sensors on industrial air compressors, achieving a 98% accuracy rate using a regression model to predict potential equipment failures.

papers.title: Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance of Industrial Machines
papers.summary: This work presents a hybrid algorithm combining fuzzy logic and machine learning for the early identification of machine faults, comparing its performance against traditional maintenance models.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Predictive Maintenance for Industrial Equipment Optimization
papers.summary: This research investigates machine learning-based predictive maintenance for industrial equipment optimization, focusing on anomaly detection and remaining useful life (RUL) estimations.

key_findings.claim: Integration of IoT and machine learning on industrial air compressors achieved a 98% accuracy level in terms of the Mean Squared Error metric.
key_findings.evidence: The model achieved 98% accuracy in the Mean Squared Error metric for our regression model.

key_findings.claim: Predictive maintenance models focus on estimating the remaining useful life (RUL) of equipment to balance cost-effectiveness and reliability.
key_findings.evidence: This research focuses on the creation of predictive maintenance models that estimate equipment's remaining useful life (RUL). The selection of thresholds for maintenance operations based on RUL projections is examined, with the goal of balancing cost-effectiveness and equipment reliability.

key_findings.claim: Hybrid algorithms combining fuzzy logic and machine learning are developed for the early identification of machine faults in industrial settings.
key_findings.evidence: To this end, a hybrid algorithm combining fuzzy logic and machine learning will be applied compared to three traditional models widely used in the literature.

overall_summary: This report reviews three academic papers published from 2023 onward focusing on predictive maintenance. The studies explore the implementation of machine learning and IoT for industrial compressors, remaining useful life (RUL) estimations for equipment optimization, and hybrid modeling approaches for early fault detection.
